constraints: integer FPS 1-240; exact ticks-per-frame; at most 20000 baked frames
data tracks only; renderer-specific parity is separate
FNV-1a integrity digest, not a cryptographic signature
data-only DAG nodes and declared blocks; no dynamic code
at most 32 embedded recipe sources and 128 ordered layers; source events require explicit composition events
positive rational rates 1..1000 with clamp, loop or ping-pong playback
ordered replace, add and multiply blends with fixed-point weights between zero and one
named easing is loss-declared when normalized to smoothstep
static proof; not final animation appearance
generic presentation geometry; at most 256 frames and 16777216 logical pixels; SVG is not raster parity proof
reuses axm.sprite-atlas/v1 and binds every emitted atlas cell to one baked frame
candidate-only Asset Hand; no automatic promotion
